title: Start with the system before the screen
summary: A practical way to turn a vague website, CRM automation or AI workflow request into entities, workflows and decisions your team can build around.
body: Most failed builds start with screens too early. We map the operating system first: who enters data, where it moves, what decisions it supports, which handoffs need proof and where AI should assist rather than guess.

title: Designing a lead pipeline that does not leak
summary: How we model forms, qualification states, reminders, lead routing and owner handoffs so sales teams stop losing high-intent enquiries.
body: A useful CRM starts with a small number of states and very clear responsibility. Capture, qualify, assign, follow up and close should leave an audit trail before AI enrichment or automation is added.

title: Dashboards need operators, not just charts
summary: A dashboard becomes useful when each metric has an owner, a cadence and an action that follows from the number changing.
body: The best dashboards are boring in the right way. They answer the same operational questions every morning, show where CRM data is weak and make it obvious what needs attention.
